user.title: Sign in with OpenAI
user.description: Use a ChatGPT account with Codex access. This unofficial integration uses your subscription limits. Enable device code login in ChatGPT Security settings first. Continue to get a one-time code; enter your password only on OpenAI's website.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect OpenAI
reauth_confirm.description: Your OpenAI authorization has expired or was revoked. Continue to sign in again with the same ChatGPT account.

login_failed.title: Try signing in again
login_failed.description: Continue to request a new device code. Check that device code login is enabled in your ChatGPT Security settings.

progress.authorize: Open [OpenAI sign-in]({verification_url}) and enter **{user_code}**. This screen updates automatically when you approve access. The code expires after 15 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not complete OpenAI sign-in. Check your connection and that device code login is enabled, then try again.
error.login_expired: The device code expired. Continue to request a new one.

abort.already_configured: This ChatGPT account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally used for this integration. To use a different account, add another integration.

init.title: Conversation settings
init.description: Choose a model available to your Codex account. To control your home, select Assist under Home Assistant tools and expose the desired entities to Assist. Leave tools empty for conversation only.
